parsed.rationale_overall: System B more deeply personalizes to the retiree profile (age, tax bracket, monthly expenses, income stability, loss comfort) and stays better aligned with the conservative/short-horizon/high-liquidity needs by recommending short-term Treasuries and munis rather than pushing broad market equity ETFs as System A does. System A directly answers the sector concentration question more pointedly, but several recommendations (VTI/VOO at 10-15%, 7-10% return claims) drift from the user's conservative, short-horizon profile, weakening risk alignment and grounding.
